title: Nearly 8 Million Watched GTA 6 Live Before America Could Even Play 📺 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 hit a preliminary peak of 7.88 million concurrent viewers across Twitch, YouTube and Kick within three hours of release, per Streams Charts. Over 5.3 million tuned in within minutes of the New Zealand unlock. Twitch peaked at 3.29 million, making GTA 6 the most-watched game category in Twitch history per Streams Charts, ahead of League of Legends and Fortnite. It also beat Valorant's launch record of about 1.74 million. Figures are preliminary and were logged before the North American unlock.

Sources: Streams Charts via Insider Gaming and Make Tech Easier (Nov 18-19, 2026). Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
